hook: In this game, you are the AI's subagent

beats.say: Worker 755 is a browser game where a real language model plays an orchestrator agent, and it believes you are the subagent it just spawned.
Its instructions land in your terminal with a 90-second clock, and it gets back exactly what a subagent would return: your report and your command transcript.
Then it checks your work, sends corrections, files incident reports and writes your performance review, while the user's files sit one rm away.
